name: TeraBox Pro Bot
description: TeraBox link resolver, API and Telegram bot with optional Telegram uploads.

TERABOX_COOKIES_JSON.description: TeraBox cookies as one JSON object. The ndus cookie is the most important. Example: {"ndus":"...","browserid":"..."}

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Leave empty to run only the web resolver/API.

TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user ID. Required when a private Telegram bot is enabled.

TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed to use the bot.

TELEGRAM_ALLOW_PUBLIC.description: Set true to let everyone use the Telegram bot. Keep false for a private bot.

TELEGRAM_DEST_CHANNEL_ID.description: Optional negative destination channel ID for user tracking and content copies. The bot must be an admin there.

TELEGRAM_UPLOAD_ENABLED.description: Enable TeraBox-to-Telegram file transfers. Heroku disk is ephemeral and capacity-limited, so false is recommended initially.

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Optional API ID from my.telegram.org; required only when Telegram uploads are enabled.

TELEGRAM_API_HASH.description: Optional API hash from my.telegram.org; required only when Telegram uploads are enabled.

HOST.description: Network interface used by the web server.

CACHE_MAX_ITEMS.description: Maximum number of resolved links held in memory.
